title: the_garden jar Background Music Replacement
description: oo very sad and nostalgic music bg ooo
body:
So basically replaces all of the minecraft musics and songs with the_garden.jar instead

inspired by: https://modrinth.com/mod/the_garden.jar

You can use it for: Beta/Alpha/Nostalgic mc modpacks, the_garden.jar modpacks and so on i dont really know what else to put here lol

For those who wants to listen to the music without downloading this: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sZ4rKM2jOFE&t=856s (some of them dont exist in this resource pack but alright)
